news.title: NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
lines: DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game. ★★★★★★: Hoederer ★★★★★: Vendela ★★★★★: Delphine ★★★★: Verdant

NOTE: - New Operator Delphine can only be obtained from The Happy Windermere Family in Episode 13: The Whirlpool that is Passion, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- After the From Gleams And Smoke I Emerge ends, Hoederer, Vendela, and Verdant will become available in other Standard Headhuntings after April 30, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- During April 16, 2024, 10:00 - April 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7), Operator Hoederer, Vendela, Delphine, and Verdant will gain more Trust from all stages that consume Sanity (except Annihilation, Intermezzi, and Side Story stages).

news.title: LIMITED-TIME TACTICAL SUPPORT EVENT - PHRASE II
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by clearing stages in 'Main Theme' and Supplies stages to obtain Milestone Fragments and rewards, including new Home Screen UI, Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supplies VI, etc; players can complete missions in [Support Memo] to obtain rewards, including Emergency Sanity Booster, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Milestone Fragments etc. Furthermore, all Operators will earn more Trust in Main Theme stages and Supplies stages after certain requirement being met; certain Operators can receive additional Trust boosts. The two effects can stack.
NOTE：
The Emergency Sanity Booster and the Emergency Sanity Concentrate gained from this event will expire on May 20, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7).
Increase your Milestone bonus by progressing through Main Theme stages during the event period.
Players who have met the requirements of the [Support Memo] missions before the event can receive the rewards directly after the event opens.

During the event, players can unlock Trust boost for Operators after clearing 11-4 under any Environment; players who have already cleared 11-4 before the event can directly gain the effect. After new Episode opens, players can unlock the additional Trust boost after clearing 13-1 under any Environment.
After Phrase II opens, the following Operators will gain more trust during the event: Hoederer, Vendela, Delphine, and Verdant.
The mentioned Trust-up effect stacks with the "New Operators Trust-up" bonus.
